message: 謎の転校生ＶＳ謎の実習生

name: Lolotte
message: 「Any crybabies 'round heeeere? Any bad kids 'round heeeeeere?」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san, what are you shouting about?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I heard it's tradition to shout like this when searching for bad kids.」

name: Azel
message: 「What's all the racket? Dismissal time has passed. Go home.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, sorry. Wait, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「...It's just you two.」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you doing here yourself, Azel-san?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Making a racket this late at night makes you a delinquent, you know.」

name: Azel
message: 「That applies to you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Were you borrowing books again?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right.」
Hmm. Going to the library isn't a bad thing, though maybe I should subtly ask Melilot-san to send her home a bit earlier?

name: Misa
message: 「Could it be that the female student wandering around late at night is.」

name: Synn
message: 「Probably.」
It's the second time, after all. That settles it.

name: Lolotte
message: 「You two are suspecting Azel-san, aren't you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Suspecting her of what?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You don't need to spell it out. Mysterious transfer students are classic suspects, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In fact, being a time traveler, an alien, an invader, an extradimensional being, or an esper--they're bursting with suspiciousness.」

name: Misa
message: 「That was written in your guidebook, wasn't it. Not that I suspected anything in the first place...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However! Azel-san is definitely not one of those! I guarantee it!」

name: Misa
message: 「You're awfully confident, so what's your basis?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's because... ahem.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because she's a fellow member of the Student Council. She's as virtuous as an angel.」

name: Misa
message: 「Like an angel...」

name: Azel
message: 「What is Lolotte saying?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... she's saying that you're a good girl, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「Naturally.」

name: Azel
message: 「There is no one who walks a more righteous path than I.」
Can an academy student who barely attends classes really be called righteous?

name: Azel
message: 「What is the meaning of that silence.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'll walk you back.」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't need an escort.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why are you following me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I have to patrol around the dorms too.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Enemies often lurk surprisingly close by, you know. It's quite common for a monster's nest to be right beneath the dorms.」

name: Misa
message: 「And that was written in the guidebook, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, it was in a horror movie I watched with my butler the day before yesterday.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Do as you please.」

name: Synn
message: 「Someone's coming.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh, but isn't Azel the rumored female student.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It must be the monster from beneath the dorms!」

name: Woman's Voice
message: 「What are you all doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「That voice sounds familiar...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sengen'in-sensei!」
Emerging in the glow of the lights lining the path was Sengen'in-sensei.
She was looking at us with cold eyes. It felt uncomfortable.

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Misa Brigitta Cristelis. And...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm Synn Sakura.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm Lolotte Rosenkreuz.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's A--」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「What am I to make of the Student Council officers taking the lead in breaking school rules?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, you see, rumors have been spreading lately about a suspicious person loitering around after curfew, so the Student Council is conducting an independent investigation.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I have already heard about that from the chairman. In other words--」
The teacher looked at Azel. Her gaze was cold.
Yet, I felt like there was an irreverent glint in her eyes, as if she were somehow amused.

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Are you saying she is the suspicious person?」

name: Azel
message: 「I was just going to the library.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Can you prove it?」

name: Azel
message: 「The librarian can.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I see. Do try your best not to give yourself away.」
The teacher disappeared into the darkness.

name: Lolotte
message: 「That teacher gives me a bad feeling.」

name: Misa
message: 「She's strict, isn't she? Her classes are easy to understand, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't let your guard down since she calls on people constantly, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? How come you don't know?」

name: Misa
message: 「Azel-san, you haven't been going to class, have you!」
